initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is mapped to surface_area with a >= threshold. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. The energy class requirement (C or better) has no reference column and is not applied.
A university student residence needs schools and universities within easy reach. Set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the classes A1 through C are accepted. Square footage (at least 850 sqm), capacity (60 people), office use and CDP/PNRR funding are not energy columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type), gross floor area of at least 850 sqm (surface_area), energy class A1-C, and education score of at least 75. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id. The requested capacity of 60 people has no matching column and is not filtered.
